summary: Build 20 FINAL regression PASS (backend 5/5 + frontend 100% smoke). Preview mirror /api/v1/ads/quota: valid userId (install-qa-1) -> 200 {userId,cap:30,ssvConfirmedToday:0,remaining:30,utcDay:YYYY-MM-DD}; short userId (ab) -> 400; missing userId -> 400. Preview player login (qa.player@vaultpop.app) still 200. Frontend gameplay countdown gating verified end-to-end: PLAY -> gameplay-countdown overlay visible immediately, HUD timer stayed at 60s at t~0.5s AND t~1.9s (proved no tick during countdown), gameplay-finish-button aria-disabled=true during countdown, overlay dismissed after ~2.8s, timer then decremented to 58s (ticking after GO), Finish -> /results shows result-summary with BOTH stat rows: 'BEST/CHAIN/VAULTS' and 'BEST GROUP/POPS/HIDDEN BOOSTERS'. Shop 'Styles & Customization' section: all 5 style cards render with testIDs cosmetic-theme-{midnight-vault, cyan-circuit, emerald-pulse, violet-neon, vaultpass-prism} each with 5-coin preview row (per-style palettes visible; Cyan Circuit=squares, Violet Neon + VaultPass Prism=gem cut confirmed in screenshots). Rewarded section copy verified: 'Daily limit per player: 30' and 'X / 30 rewarded ads used today (your account)' visible. Shop buy buttons on web preview correctly show 'Available on the App Store' label with aria-disabled=true (StoreKit inert on web is EXPECTED, no busy state ever gets stuck — button state does not persist as busy after taps; multiple sequential taps did not lock UI). Auth regression: player login shows 'Player account' + NO admin-console button; admin login (qa.owner.b15@vaultpop.test) shows 'Owner account' label + OWNER TOOLS section + account-admin-console-button. Settings + Support screens render cleanly. Zero console errors, zero pageerrors across all screens.
